design: Use the v2 scramble, ball and wheel limits, six active players, 100 Hz attribution and 24-second games. Count only the first contest, including failures to recover in the denominator. Each held-out start gets a new Webots process. Freeze before every qualification. A failed version needs a changed policy and the next disjoint 1000-seed block. Report every attempted panel. Three prespecified 35-second demo games include one ordinary start.
